title: Ezra Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Ezra 4: the adversaries oppose the rebuilding, and Artaxerxes orders the work in Jerusalem to stop.

questions.text: What did the adversaries of Judah and Benjamin ask Zerubbabel and the heads of households?
questions.explanation: They said, "Let us build with you; for we seek your God, as you do."

answers.text: To leave the land at once
To be allowed to build with them
To give them the temple vessels

questions.text: Since the days of which king of Assyria did the adversaries say they had been sacrificing?
questions.explanation: They said they had been sacrificing to him since the days of Esar Haddon king of Assyria, who brought them up there.

questions.text: How did Zerubbabel, Jeshua and the heads of households answer them?
questions.explanation: They said, "You have nothing to do with us in building a house to our God," for they would build as king Cyrus had commanded.

answers.text: "You have nothing to do with us"
"You are welcome to build with us"

questions.text: What did the people of the land hire against the people of Judah?
questions.explanation: They hired counselors against them, to frustrate their purpose, all the days of Cyrus king of Persia, even until the reign of Darius.

answers.text: Merchants to raise the price of timber
Robbers to steal the building stones

questions.text: In what language was the letter to Artaxerxes written and delivered?
questions.explanation: The writing of the letter was written in Syrian, and delivered in the Syrian language.

questions.text: Who wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king?
questions.explanation: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe wrote a letter against Jerusalem to Artaxerxes the king.

answers.text: Rehum the chancellor and Shimshai the scribe
Hilkiah the priest and Shaphan the scribe

questions.text: What did the letter warn would happen if the city were built and the walls finished?
questions.explanation: They wrote that if this city is built and the walls finished, they will not pay tribute, custom, or toll.

answers.text: They would join the king of Egypt
They would not pay tribute, custom, or toll

questions.text: What did Artaxerxes say was found when search was made?
questions.explanation: The king said it was found that this city has made insurrection against kings in the past, and that rebellion and revolts have been made in it.

answers.text: The city had always paid its tribute
The Jews had never lived in the city
The city had been built by the Persians
The city had made insurrection against kings in the past

questions.text: How did Rehum, Shimshai and their companions make the Jews stop?
questions.explanation: They went in haste to Jerusalem to the Jews, and made them to cease by force of arms.

questions.text: Until when did the work on God's house at Jerusalem stop?
questions.explanation: The work stopped until the second year of the reign of Darius king of Persia.

answers.text: Until the first year of Cyrus
Until the second year of Darius king of Persia
Until the seventh year of Artaxerxes
